title: Simplify the Course: Specs workflow
body: Asks for Complete checklist, Run AI AGENT, CHECK REFERENCES, Approved and Dependency to be removed from the work type that creates Business Specs & Outline, possibly by swapping in an existing basic workflow. Done: the work type was moved onto the shared CDLC: Task/Subtask workflow, which Sub-task and Task also use.
before: Its own workflow, 10 statuses: To Do · In Progress · Complete checklist · Run AI AGENT · CHECK REFERENCES · In Review · Approved · Dependency · Suspended · Done
after: The shared CDLC: Task/Subtask workflow, 6 statuses: To Do · In Progress · In Review · On Hold · Suspended · Done

title: New work item type for video creation and recording
body: Specifies a full workflow with two review gates and loop-backs on failure. Also meant to replace the video creation task inside the Applied Layers workflow.
after: To Do → Storyboard → SME Review → (fail: Storyboard | pass: Video Creation) → SME Review → (fail: Video Creation | pass: In Review) → (fail: Video Creation | pass: Done). On Hold and Suspended reachable from any status.

title: Add an SME to the SME group and field
body: New subject matter expert added to Jira, to the SME group, and to the SME dropdown field.

title: Require a Final Storyline Link before Articulate work can close
body: Visual Designers were not updating the Storyline file after Articulate review. A new field was created and a validator now blocks the move to Done until it is filled.
before: Articulate work types could move to Done with no record of the final Storyline file
after: Final Storyline Link required before Done on CDLC: Articulate Review and Certification: Articulate Creation
subTickets: Create the field, add it to screen, screen scheme and layout
Add the validator to both Articulate workflows

title: Add a plumbing SME to the SME dropdown
body: a plumbing SME added to the list of SMEs available in the Jira field.

title: Fix courses stuck at 5% completion on the project dashboard
body: Epic percentage complete was not advancing past 5% for a set of courses.

title: Backfill Planning and Production Link on earlier tickets
body: Tickets created before those links existed were never populated. The automation now fills them in retrospectively.

title: Build the Applied Layers workflows from scratch
body: Five new work types for hands-on task courses, each at course level but not itself a course. Toolkit and Instructions share one workflow; the other three got bespoke ones.
before: No Applied Layers work types existed
after: Toolkit and Instructions: To Do · Assigned · In Progress · In Review · Done. Content Finalization: Finalize as per SME Requirements · Generate Graphic Definition · Referencing. Video Recording: Video Recording · Manual Edit · Video Review. Video Creation: Storyboard · Video Creation · SME Review · In Review · Done
subTickets: Create the five Applied Layers work types
Finalize workflows for Toolkit, Instructions and Video Creation
Create workflows for Content Finalization, Video Recording and Video Creation
Auto-create all five when an epic is opened with Course Type = Hands-on Task
Set up Excel sheets for import

title: Certification work types are being created multiple times
body: The automation fires more than once when the trigger item moves to Done, producing duplicate tickets. Open since early July.

title: Show outline readiness in the epic progress bar
body: Request: if epic percentage is above 0% but no topic has progressed, that should read as "outline ready".

title: Exclude Translation from Certification course progress
body: Certification courses have no translation step, so counting it was holding their completion percentage down.

title: Let users skip Spanish Translations
body: Workflow changed so the Spanish Translations status is no longer mandatory on the way through.

title: Rebuild the Certification: Articulate Creation workflow
body: The workflow shipped a month earlier was too thin. Corrections, SME Review and Quality Review were added, In Review was renamed, and loop-backs were defined so a failed review returns to ID Review.
before: To Do → Generate Articulate → In Review → Done
after: To Do → Generate Articulate → ID Review ⇄ Corrections → SME Review → Quality review → Done, with SME Review and Quality review able to send it back to ID Review

title: Restructure digitization into sub-tasks
body: The single Digitization Process ticket was broken into eleven sub-task work types, each with its own workflow, and every digitization automation was rewritten to point at them.
before: One flat Digitization Process work type
after: Eleven sub-task work types: Badge Creation, Upload to AWS + Planning, Review, Restore on SkillCat, Data Sheet Creation, Content Upkeep, Run Image Archiving, Course Catalog Updating, Generate Performance Report, Move Source Files, Restrict Course Folder
subTickets: Create Course Introduction, assigned to the ID named in Contributors
Create the eleven sub-task work types
Auto-create CDLC: Topic as soon as the epic moves to Digitization
Associate a workflow with each of the eleven new work types
Repoint every digitization automation at the new work types
Switch all copied fields to {{triggerIssue.…}} syntax
Retire the Digitization Process work type in favour of Digitization - Data Sheet Creation
Remove the backwards transitions out of QA Review on Restore on SkillCat

title: Make translations drive the parent topic
body: Two automations so the Topic follows its Translation sub-task instead of being moved by hand.
after: Translation → Upload to AWS also moves the Topic to Upload to AWS. Translation → Done also moves the Topic to Done.

title: A field for translations?
body: Open question, never specified further.

title: Fix how Visual Designer is copied
body: Automations using "Copy from Parent" were replaced with an explicit {{issue.parent.Visual Designer(s)}} reference across at least five automations, including Topic creation, Certification PPTX and the digitization chain.

title: Add validators across CDLC
body: An umbrella for gating transitions on required fields. Three shipped, six were discarded and two are still parked. The pattern that survived was: block the transition, not the ticket creation.
subTickets: Graphics can't leave In Review without Articulate Review Link and VD filled
Sub-tasks need Target End Date and Checklist to leave To Do, across eight work types
Epic can't move to Digitization until ID, VD and QA Specialist are filled
Spanish file required before a translation can move on
Topic name required before To Do → In Progress — blocked, because Topic is moved entirely by automation
Seven fields required before Epic leaves To Do
Checklist added to epic or topic
Epic can't be created without Course Type and Contributors
Topic can't reach Final Slides without Checklist and Contributors
Topic can only close once every sub-task is Done

title: Delete duplicate work types
body: Names the exact problem still visible in the config today: CDLC: Assessment and CDLC: Topic Assessment both exist, and the same doubling runs across many work types. The plan was to filter for tickets of the dead type, migrate them, then delete it.

title: Build the Certification course track
body: Five new work types with their own workflows and automations, triggered when an epic is created with Course Type set to Certification.
after: Template Generation: To Do · Done. Research Note: To Do → Manual Review → Inline Image Check → Done. Slide Chunks: To Do → In Progress → Paraphrasing → In Review → Done. Graphic Definitions: To Do → Generate Graphic Definition → Review & Revise Definition → Review & Revise Visuals → Generate AI Visuals → Review Final GD → Done. Articulate Creation: To Do → Generate Articulate → In Review → Done
subTickets: Create the five Certification work types
Define all five workflows, and remove "Add Video Links" from PPT Generation
Automations: create Template Generation on Certification epics, populate Course Type on every topic

title: Fix fields not copying from epic to child items
body: ID, VD and QA were not reaching newly created topics. Eleven automations were edited, including Topic Created, Create Base Articulate File, Final Slides complete, Move Source Files and Restrict Course Folder.

title: Standardize the review status name
body: Three work types each called the same stage something different. The decision was to settle on Quality review.
before: Final Slides said In Review, Articulate said Quality Review, Digitization: Review said QA Review
after: All three set to Quality review — though QA Review is still live today on both Restore on SkillCat work types

title: Automate start and end dates
body: Never specified further.

title: Fill Contributors automatically from Assignee
body: The idea was to derive Contributors from whoever is assigned and which group they belong to. Scope was cut back in July to Visual Designer and Digitization Resource only. Digitization Resource is the hard case, because it is a dropdown of people who are not Jira users.
subTickets: Check the members of each group
Narrow scope to VD and Digitization Resource

title: Make the automations leaner
body: Every automation was separately checking which work type it was looking at, which was burning through the automation budget. Redundant condition checks were stripped and overlapping rules merged.
subTickets: Merge the two competing PPT Generation automations, which disagreed about whether Informational courses were included

title: Create the Course Briefing work type
body: For the briefing between Instructional Designer and SME, with Visual Designer and QA Specialist present. Wired into the epic creation automation.
after: CDLC: Course Brief — To Do · Assigned · In Progress · Done
subTickets: Add it to the epic creation automation

title: Add a Contributors tab beside Key Details
body: Applied to every screen scheme in CDLC.

title: Rename Data Entry Resource to Digitization Resource
body: Data migrated across, two new people added to the dropdown, and the old custom field deleted.
subTickets: Add email addresses for two Digitization team members

title: Add timelines for Digitization tasks
body: Never specified further.

title: Add a QA Review step after a course reaches production
body: A quality gate inserted into the Restore on SkillCat workflow, after In Review. The change was announced by email.
before: Restore on SkillCat ended at In Review
after: QA Review inserted after In Review
subTickets: Send out an email about the change

title: Give different work types different layouts
body: Every CDLC work type except Epic shares one layout, so Production Link shows up on tickets that have no use for it — including early-stage Final Slides and Articulate Review work.

title: Cascade the course links from epic to children
body: Course Folder Link, Planning Link and Production Link now flow down from the epic instead of being typed in repeatedly. Two validators were added so the links can't be skipped.
subTickets: Copy Planning Link onto the Digitization Process ticket and everything after it
Copy Production Link onto the Digitization Process ticket and everything after it
Planning Link required to move Upload to AWS + Planning into In Review
Production Link required to move Restore on SkillCat into In Review

title: Stop pulling the Articulate link from the epic
body: Automations were copying Articulate Review Link from the parent epic, but the epic has no such field — every topic has its own link. The fix was to read from CDLC: Topic instead. Dropped after a follow-up review.

title: List automations costing more time than they save
body: An audit that was never completed.

title: Plan the Jira workflow for translations after corrections
body: Parked.

title: Document the workflows and automations
body: Paired with SGP-9078, which documented the Jira work types.

title: JIRA Workflow
body: Closed with no description recorded, so what changed here is not recoverable from Jira.

title: Add the image archiving ticket to the digitization chain
body: Every course needs its images extracted and tagged. A new ticket now appears automatically once Restore to SkillCat closes, and closing it in turn creates the Move Source Files ticket.
after: Run Image Archiving Automation — To Do · In Progress · In Review · Done, auto-created after Restore to SkillCat and itself creating Move Source Files

title: Add a course folder move step to digitization
body: Once a course is released its folder has to move out of "Ongoing courses in progress" into Course Specific Documents. Added to the Restore on SkillCat workflow after Update Spreadsheet.
after: Step added to Restore on SkillCat, after update spreadsheet

title: Implement updated review workflows
body: Recorded only as "apply the approved changes to the review workflows, update documentation and communicate the new process". The approved changes themselves were not written down in the ticket.
